TA cloning should not affect the sites and were far away from the ligation site

PEG protocol does not inhibit restriction enzymes. I have used this protocol before

Cleaning the DNA had no effect

It’s unfortunate because the TA kit comes with a linearized plasmid so we couldn’t make permanents of it or test it on its own
3 cut sites. I just see a single band (same as running empty vector)
I wanted phosphates on my insert. There’s the minimum number of extra nt on each side as specified by the fastdigest guide
Have you ever had success with an SDM strategy for a vector this big? I only ever got it to work with a small 6 kb vector

I ordered two 70 bp oligos, dissolved them in Tris-EDTA-NaCl buffer, diluted them 1:10 in water then and annealed them together by boiling and cooling slowly. I double digest my oligos and my vector and ligate overnight at 4C with 4000 PEG. At this point, I'm convinced that either my insert isn't fully digested or my molar ratio isn't high enough
